messages.subject: linkage map, gaps between markers
parts:
I have recovered gaps that are > 50cM on a linkage group with ~350 markers and the manual mentions that gaps > 100cM (when there are large errors). There are four gaps >50cm and they are found at marker number 12, 31, 281, 304 so it does not appear that they are just appended to the end. My understanding is that distances >50cM suggest no linkage so I am unclear how the sections of the linkage group separated by these gaps are assigned to the same linkage group. And how could you recover a gap > 100cM?
thanks roberta

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] linkage map, gaps between markers
parts:
With the Haldane map function, 50 cM corresponds to a recombination fraction of ~0.32; 100 cM corresponds to a rec frac of ~0.43. With large data, you can have strong evidence for linkage even with 50 cM distances.

Also, if you use formLinkageGroups with restrictions min.lod but not on max.rf, you'll get markers placed into the same linkage group that have evidence of linkage but not be very tightly linked.

Or there could just be problems with marker order on that linkage group.

karl
